search_window.basis: Latest independently read-back-verified prior Food Line watch heartbeat completed at 21:46:56 PST Nov 2. Queries targeted most recent 1-2 days to absorb indexing lag; only events first verified after last heartbeat count.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall; authoritative Food Line national production collection remains unchanged.
target_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster of community's only, sole, last, or full-service grocery
Emergency food distribution cancellation/suspension due to storm/flood/fire/outage/facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food-bank closure or material reduction in access
New official SNAP/WIC/food assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: "food bank" suspended distribution power outage November 2026
SNAP benefits outage delayed November 2 2026 state official
coverage_notes.observation: All 12 targeted web queries executed and returned usable discovery responses. No newly verified eligible access disruption occurred within the post-21:46:56 PST observation interval. Most matches were stale or irrelevant, including prior-year SNAP halt coverage, historic disasters, unrelated outages, and routine aid news. Search-engine date relevance was weak for very recent local notices but did not fail.

excluded_examples.reason: Report dated November 2 at 7:51 PM Central (5:51 PM PST), before prior heartbeat. Ongoing application backlog sourced to Food Bank CEO, not a newly announced official stoppage.
Known SNAP eligible-item restrictions effective Nov 1 and reported Nov 2 morning, before prior heartbeat; not a newly issued aid interruption.
Federal SNAP benefit interruption from 2025, not new in 2026.
Historical program-funding changes, not a new closure or distribution stoppage.

duplicate_screen.method: Verified branch directory and prior record; screened candidate publication/event times against previous completion and excluded out-of-window reports.

coverage_notes.limitations: Twelve targeted searches are not exhaustive, and search indexing can lag same-hour local provider notices. No verified qualifying *new* item found; national absence cannot be established.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approval, publication, primary collection modification, schedule change or disabling action.
